# Replica Design, rebuild the design system for your app clone

Curated by Skill Harbor: the design-system step of the 11-skill Replica pack. Replica Design rebuilds the system behind an app, not its assets: colour roles, type scale, spacing, radius, shadows and layout measured from screenshots, then written as design tokens and component specs, with the primitives built once in isolation. It never takes the original's logos, icons, illustrations, licensed fonts, copy or signature brand colour, and it runs a WCAG contrast check until there are zero AA failures. The result is a clone that feels like the app you studied, without copying what it owns. By @Jakeschincariol, listed here with credit to its creator. Skill Harbor never reviews the code of a listed skill, so review it yourself before use.
